outputs.image_review: Actual original viewed at 1024x1024. Four exact no-border quadrants in the requested order, broad readable peeling plaster, blue-gray rounded tile rows, wide short old slabs with cracks and slight moss, dark tea-brown timber grain and joins. No people, facades, props, letters or watermarks. Selected for limited scene review; no user approval implied.
review_limits: Individual cells are not mathematically seamless. Measured opposite-edge differences are recorded; runtime cell isolation, edge handling and scale require scene review.
Paving is varied broad short slab rows rather than fully random polygonal stone placement.
The plaster includes pale off-white areas but large gray-ochre peeling patches are readable.

outputs.transforms: None. Selected runtime PNG bytes are identical to the provider download. No crop, recolor, resampling, alpha extraction or offline seam editing was performed.

No trunk, ground, cast shadow, text or watermark. The central mass is denser than the outer sprays; selected for limited scene review rather than automatic full-scene acceptance.

background.type: near-magenta RGB chroma-key, not an alpha channel

Minimum detected margin is about 4.1 percent rather than the requested 6 percent. The foliage silhouette is entirely inside the canvas and not clipped.
Actual sprite key edge, layering, size, density and color must be judged in the real game scene.
Both successful provider calls and original raster inspection are verified; actual runtime rendering and user judgment must be recorded separately.
Original provider downloads are preserved. Any runtime cropping, mipmap preparation, seamless edge handling or chroma-key operation belongs to the scene implementation and must be documented there.
